title: Sadiq Beg Attacks the Khalsa Muster near Srainwal

blocks.text: The new episode opens with a large Sikh muster, as twenty thousand Singhs assemble under leading chiefs for the seasonal movement toward Anandpur and Hola Mohalla. Tara Singh led the contingent, and the gathering is presented as both martial and devotional before politics again interrupts the journey.

Sadiq Beg has failed to honor earlier obligations, so resentment follows him even before open fighting resumes. When his revenue interests appear exposed, Sikh action against them helps turn suspicion into war and convinces him to answer with force rather than payment.

He therefore launches a sudden attack near Srainwal, trying to hit the Khalsa while it is not yet fully concentrated. The page frames his conduct as betrayal precisely because it comes after negotiation, delayed payment, and the outward signs of friendship.
